exceptions.reason: Expo, Jest and ESLint still resolve the legacy CommonJS API. Forcing brace-expansion 5 across those dependency contracts is a breaking transitive override.
exceptions.compensation: No server request path or shipped application bundle invokes glob expansion; CI passes only repository-owned paths and patterns.

exceptions.scope: frontend build tooling only (Metro, Jest and Expo CLI file maps in @crowdsource/console and @crowdsource/reviewer)
exceptions.reason: No fixed version of braces exists: the advisory covers <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the latest published release, so an override has nothing to point at. Its only path is micromatch 4, required by metro-file-map, @expo/metro-file-map, jest-haste-map and @jest/transform. @crowdsource/backend reaches it only through @oxy.so/core's optional expo peers, which the backend image omits (--omit=peer --omit=optional).
exceptions.compensation: Stack-exhaustion denial of service needs a hostile, deeply nested brace pattern. Only repository-owned globs and paths reach micromatch at build and test time; no server request path, published package or shipped app bundle expands a glob.

exceptions.scope: Expo CLI, build time only (@crowdsource/console and @crowdsource/reviewer)
exceptions.reason: No fixed version of node-forge exists: the advisory covers <=1.4.0 and 1.4.0 is the latest published release, so an override has nothing to point at. Its only paths are @expo/cli and @expo/code-signing-certificates, entered through expo by the two app workspaces; @crowdsource/backend reaches it only through @oxy.so/core's optional expo peers, which the backend image omits (--omit=peer --omit=optional).
exceptions.compensation: The flaw is lenient RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification. The repository only runs expo export for static web bundles; it never verifies expo-updates code-signing signatures, and no server request path, published package or shipped app bundle loads node-forge.
